scheme_name: Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) Internship
other_conditions: Applicant must be a student pursuing engineering, postgraduate, Ph.D., CA, CS, ICWA, CMA, or MBA degrees from a recognized institution in India or abroad
Applicant must have his own laptop for the internship
Applicant must maintain a regular schedule and demonstrate professionalism
Applicant must sign a non‑disclosure agreement to protect SECI’s data
An applicant can apply for an internship only once during a financial year
No fee will be charged to the interns
benefits_summary: Stipend of ₹8,000 per month for internships less than 6 months, or ₹12,000 per month for internships of 6 months to 3 years, plus a completion certificate.
